sect3.title: Visão Geral
sect3.para: This filter is used to remove small defects due to dust, or scratches, on a scanned image, and also moiré effects on images scanned from a magazine. You should select isolated defects before applying this filter, in order to avoid unwanted changes in other areas of your image. The filter replaces each pixel with the median value of the pixels within the specified radius.

note.para: If the image is in indexed mode, this menu entry is disabled.

sect3.title: Activating the Filter
sect3.para:
This filter is found in the main menu under
Filters Enhance Despeckle… .

listitem.para: Se estiver marcado, os resultados de parametrização são exibidos interativamente na visualização.
The median value of the pixels within the set Radius around the target pixel is used to replace the target pixel value.
Adapta o raio à imagem ou conteúdo da seleção através da análise do histograma da região em torno de um pixel alvo. O raio adaptado será sempre menor ou igual ao raio especificado.
Repeats the Median filter action to get a stronger effect.
Repeats the Adaptive filter action to get a stronger effect.
Sets size of action window from 1 (3×3 pixels) to 20 (41×41). This window moves over the image, and the color in it is smoothed, so imperfections are removed.
Só inclui pixels mais claros do que o valor definido no histograma final(-1-255).
Só inclui pixels mais escuros do que o valor definido aqui no histograma (0-256).
